annotations.title: Release on both stores at a set time

description: Asks a person to approve releasing at a set time, on one store or both together: iosReleaseId puts the version App Review approved onto the App Store (its release option must be manual: ploa_appstore_release_type), androidReleaseId sends the build to production on Google Play (rolloutPercent for a staged rollout). Once approved, each waits and goes out at its time (up to 30 days ahead); Google still reviews an Android release first, so send Android a day or two early or schedule it after Google approved. at is a time with its zone, like 2026-11-10T10:00:00+02:00. Follow each request with ploa_approval_status.

androidReleaseId.description: The Android release that goes to production.

at.description: When, as an ISO time with its zone (2026-11-10T10:00:00+02:00).

iosReleaseId.description: The iOS release whose approved version goes onto the App Store.

rolloutPercent.description: Android only: the share of users, 1 to 100. Default 100.

name: ploa_schedule_release
